subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Cyber Attacks
description: A short lesson to help you apply Cyber Attacks.

hook.text: A ransomware attack froze Maersk's IT systems for two weeks. 76 ports couldn't process a single container.

buildup.text: Cyberattacks target supply chain IT: ERP systems, logistics platforms, and supplier portals.

discovery.text: A successful attack can halt operations, corrupt data, and expose sensitive supplier and customer information.

twist.text: Attackers increasingly target smaller suppliers as entry points into larger companies' networks.

climax.text: The Maersk NotPetya attack cost $300 million. Rebuilding 45,000 PCs and 4,000 servers took ten days.

punchline.text: A cyberattack can stop physical goods as fast as a flood.

quiz.question: How much did the NotPetya attack cost Maersk?
